args: Read {{OPS_DIR}}/RUNBOOK.md and run the incremental AGENTS.md sync strictly step-by-step: 1) run {{PYTHON_CMD}} "{{OPS_DIR}}/memsync.py" lint and read the generated lint report; 2) run {{PYTHON_CMD}} "{{OPS_DIR}}/memsync.py" sync-plan and read work/sync-plan-<today>.md (exit cleanly with SKIP report if nothing changed or index-only mode is active); 3) Stage 1: for each workspace marked NEEDS_UPDATE, read work/sync-ws-<ws>-<today>.md, write draft to work/draft-ws-<ws>-<today>.md matching the required sections, and run memsync.py apply --scope <ws>; 4) Stage 2: if [global] is NEEDS_UPDATE, run memsync.py global-input, read work/sync-global-<today>.md, write draft-global-<today>.md, and run memsync.py apply --scope global; 5) output only the concise summary format defined in RUNBOOK.md. Never edit GEMINI.md, memories/*.md, config.json, sync-state.json, or AGENTS.md directly.
description: Daily {{SCHEDULE_TIME}} ({{TIMEZONE}}) incremental distillation from changed memories into workspace and global AGENTS.md snapshot caches.
